tasks.subject: Map application and specifications
tasks.description: Identify app architecture, authoritative specifications, implementation surfaces, test suites, run commands, and critical user journeys across backend and mobile/web.

tasks.subject: Run automated quality checks
tasks.description: Execute project-native backend, frontend/mobile, lint, typecheck, build, and integration checks; capture exact commands, outcomes, and failures without modifying source.

tasks.subject: Exercise critical E2E journeys
tasks.description: Start the application per project docs and validate critical browser-visible journeys against the product spec, recording screenshots/logs and classifying failures.

tasks.subject: Perform full code and security review
tasks.description: Review the complete current application and uncommitted implementation against specifications, using fresh critic and security-auditor sessions and parent verification for serious findings.
tasks.activeForm: Performing full code and security review

tasks.subject: Produce comprehensive review report
tasks.description: Synthesize spec coverage, automated test evidence, E2E evidence, verified findings by severity, gaps, and release recommendation into a clear report.

tasks.subject: Plan comprehensive remediation
tasks.description: Produce an implementation plan covering every verified review finding: Unicode experiment fingerprints, crisis voice shutdown, rate limiting and quotas, loopback datastore exposure, transactional conversation close, recording mute behavior, provider consent/disclosure, deletion/account erasure semantics, dependency pinning, formatting, tests, and E2E reliability.

tasks.subject: Implement reviewed fixes
tasks.description: Apply the approved remediation plan across backend, mobile, infrastructure, CI, documentation, and tests without overwriting unrelated user changes.

tasks.subject: Verify all automated checks
tasks.description: Run formatting, lint, backend unit/integration, mobile typecheck/Jest, ontology, benchmark, migration, and canonical E2E checks after implementation.

tasks.subject: Review remediation independently
tasks.description: Run a fresh security-sensitive FULL code review of the completed remediation and verify any serious findings.
